extintor.title: Guide - Fire Extinguisher Inspection
extintor.howToRegisterInspectionContent:
1. Go to **"Inspections"** → **"Extinguishers"**
2. Tap on the desired extinguisher
3. Tap **"Register New Inspection"**
4. Fill in:
   - **Inspection Date** (required)
   - **Service Type:** Inspection, Maintenance N2, Maintenance N3 or Replacement
   - **Approved in Inspection?:** Yes or No
   - **General Observations** (optional)
5. If rejected, attach photo (required)
6. Tap **"Save Inspection"**
extintor.howToRegisterEquipmentContent:
1. Go to **"Inspections"** → **"Extinguishers"**
2. Tap the **"+"** button in the bottom right corner
3. Fill in the equipment data
4. Tap **"Save"**
extintor.faqPhotoAnswer: Whenever the extinguisher is rejected in the inspection (required).

add_extintor.title: Guide - Add Extinguisher
add_extintor.howToRegisterContent:
1. **ID Number:** Optional. If left empty, the system generates a unique code automatically.
2. **Specifications:** Select the agent type (Water, Dry Chemical, CO2) and capacity.
3. **Location:** Describe where the equipment is installed.

mangueira.title: Guide - Hoses
mangueira.howToRegisterContent:
1. Go to **"Inspections"** → **"Hoses"**
2. Tap the **"+"** button
3. Fill in: ID, diameter, type, length, year of manufacture
4. Tap **"Save"**
mangueira.faqFrequencyAnswer: Annual hydrostatic test required according to NBR 12779.

add_mangueira.title: Guide - Add Hose
add_mangueira.howToRegisterContent:
1. **Hose ID:** Optional. Automatically generated if empty.
2. **Type:** I, II, III, IV or V.
3. **Length:** In meters (e.g., 15, 20, 30).
4. **Diameter:** In millimeters (e.g., 40, 65).
5. **Manufacture Year:** Year stamped on the hose.

add_camara_espuma.title: Guide - Add Foam Chamber
add_camara_espuma.howToRegisterContent:
1. **Chamber ID:** Optional. Automatically generated if empty.
2. **Location:** Tank or protected area.
3. **Model:** Chamber model.
4. **MCS Number:** If applicable.

add_canhao_monitor.title: Guide - Add Monitor Cannon
add_canhao_monitor.howToRegisterContent:
1. **Equipment ID:** Optional. Automatically generated if empty.
2. **Location:** Installation area.
3. **Model:** Cannon model.
4. **Type:** Fixed or Portable.
5. **Flow Rate:** Nominal flow rate (e.g., 1000 gpm).

add_chuveiro_lavaolhos.title: Guide - Add Eyewash Station
add_chuveiro_lavaolhos.howToRegisterContent:
1. **Equipment ID:** Optional. Automatically generated if empty.
2. **Location:** Near which chemical/physical risk.
3. **Model:** Equipment model.
4. **Type:** Shower, Eyewash or Combined.

add_alarme.title: Guide - Add Alarm System
add_alarme.howToRegisterContent:
1. **System ID:** Optional. Automatically generated if empty.
2. **Location:** Coverage area.
3. **Brand/Model:** Manufacturer and model of the control panel/device.
4. **Type:** Control Panel, Manual Call Point, Siren, Detector.

add_multigas.title: Guide - Add Multigas Detector
add_multigas.howToRegisterContent:
1. **Equipment ID:** Optional. Automatically generated if empty.
2. **Brand/Model:** Manufacturer and model.
3. **Serial No:** Manufacturer's serial number.
4. **Calibration Date:** Date of last calibration.
5. **Sensor Validity:** Expiration date of sensors.

add_scba.title: Guide - Add SCBA
add_scba.howToRegisterContent:
1. **Serial No:** Optional. Automatically generated if empty.
2. **Manufacturer/Model:** Brand and model of the equipment.
3. **Capacity:** Cylinder volume (e.g., 6.8L).
4. **Max Pressure:** Working pressure (e.g., 300 bar).

add_abrigo.title: Guide - Add Shelter
add_abrigo.howToRegisterContent:
1. **Shelter ID:** Optional. Automatically generated if empty.
2. **Location:** Where the shelter is installed.
3. **Type:** Hydrant or Extinguisher.
4. **Items:** List contained items (hoses, nozzles, keys).

add_custom.title: Guide - Add Custom Equipment
add_custom.howToRegisterContent:
1. **ID:** Optional. Automatically generated if empty.
2. **Custom Fields:** Fill in specific fields defined for this equipment type.
3. **Location:** If requested, provide the location.

custom_type.title: Guide - Create Equipment Type
custom_type.howToRegisterContent:
1. **Type Name:** Name that will appear in menus (e.g., Pump, Generator).
2. **Slug:** Unique identifier generated from the name.
3. **ID Field:** Define how the equipment ID will be called (e.g., TAG, Asset).
4. **Location/GPS:** Mark if you want to track location or coordinates.

custom_checklist.title: Guide - Create Checklist
custom_checklist.howToRegisterContent:
1. **Sections:** Group questions by category (e.g., Electrical, Mechanical).
2. **Questions:** Type the item to be verified.
3. **Order:** Items will appear in the order they were created.

camara_espuma.title: Guide - Foam Chambers
camara_espuma.howToRegisterInspectionContent:
1. Go to **"Inspections"** → **"Foam Chambers"**
2. Tap on the desired chamber
3. Tap **"Register New Inspection"**
4. Fill in the date
5. Choose type: **Semiannual Visual** or **Annual Functional**
6. Complete the checklist
7. If there is non-conformity or functional test, attach photo
8. Tap **"Save Inspection"**
camara_espuma.faqFrequencyAnswer: Semiannual visual (6 months) and annual functional required.

canhao_monitor.title: Guide - Monitor Cannons
canhao_monitor.howToRegisterInspectionContent:
1. Go to **"Inspections"** → **"Monitor Cannons"**
2. Tap on the desired cannon
3. Tap **"Register New Inspection"**
4. Fill in the date
5. Choose type: **Visual** or **Functional**
6. Complete the checklist
7. If there is non-conformity, attach photo
8. Tap **"Save Inspection"**
canhao_monitor.faqFrequencyAnswer: Quarterly visual inspection and annual functional test required.

chuveiro_lavaolhos.title: Guide - Eyewash Stations
chuveiro_lavaolhos.howToRegisterInspectionContent:
1. Go to **"Inspections"** → **"Eyewash Stations"**
2. Tap on the desired equipment
3. Tap **"Register New Inspection"**
4. Fill in the date
5. Complete the checklist
6. If there is non-conformity, attach photo (required)
7. Tap **"Save Inspection"**
chuveiro_lavaolhos.faqFrequencyAnswer: Monthly inspection required according to NR 20.

alarme.title: Guide - Alarm Systems
alarme.howToRegisterInspectionContent:
1. Go to **"Inspections"** → **"Alarm Systems"**
2. Tap on the desired system
3. Tap **"Register New Inspection"**
4. Fill in the date
5. Complete the checklist
6. If there is non-conformity, attach photo
7. Tap **"Save Inspection"**
alarme.faqFrequencyAnswer: Monthly inspection required according to NFPA 72.

multigas.title: Guide - Multigas Detectors
multigas.howToRegisterTestContent:
1. Go to **"Inspections"** → **"Multigas Detectors"**
2. Tap on the desired detector
3. Tap **"Register New Inspection"**
4. Fill in the date and time of the test
5. Choose type: **Periodic** or **Extraordinary**
6. Fill in cylinder reference values (LEL, O², H²S, CO)
7. Fill in values found in the test
8. Mark if you want to update values permanently
9. Add observations (optional)
10. Tap **"Save Inspection"**
multigas.faqFrequencyAnswer: Daily/weekly bump test before use in critical environments.

scba.title: Guide - Self-Contained Breathing Apparatus (SCBA)
scba.howToRegisterInspectionContent:
1. Go to **"Inspections"** → **"Self-Contained Breathing Apparatus (SCBA)"**
2. Tap on the desired SCBA
3. Tap **"Register New Inspection"**
4. Fill in the date
5. Complete the checklist (includes functional tests)
6. Add observations if necessary
7. Tap **"Save Inspection"**
scba.faqFrequencyAnswer: Monthly visual inspection required and before each use.

abrigo.title: Guide - Emergency Shelters
abrigo.howToRegisterInspectionContent:
1. Go to **"Inspections"** → **"Emergency Shelters"**
2. Tap on the desired shelter
3. Tap **"Register New Inspection"**
4. Fill in the date
5. Mark status: **Approved** or **Rejected**
6. Add observations (optional)
7. If rejected, attach photo
8. Tap **"Save Inspection"**
abrigo.faqFrequencyAnswer: Monthly inspection required according to NBR 13714.

custom.title: Guide - Custom Inspection
custom.howToRegisterInspectionContent:
1. Go to **"Inspections"** → Select the equipment type
2. Tap on the desired equipment
3. Tap **"Register New Inspection"**
4. Complete the custom checklist
5. If there is non-conformity, attach photo
6. Tap **"Save Inspection"**

qr_generator.title: Guide - QR Code Generator
qr_generator.howToUseContent:
1. **Select:** Choose existing equipment to generate automatic codes.
2. **Search:** Find specific equipment by ID or Serial.
3. **Manual:** Type a list of IDs to generate multiple codes at once.
4. **Download:** Download in PNG or share the generated code.

qr_scan.title: Guide - Scan Equipment
qr_scan.howToRegisterContent:
1. **Camera:** Point at the equipment QR code.
2. **Focus:** Keep the code centered and wait for it to be read.
3. **Manual:** If the code is damaged, use the manual search option.

dashboard.title: Dashboard Guide
dashboard.subtitle: Overview of the status of all equipment
dashboard.whatYouSee: What do you see on the Dashboard?
dashboard.whatYouSeeContent:
**Metrics (top cards):**
- 📊 **Total:** Total number of registered equipment
- ✅ **OK:** Equipment in compliance
- ⚠️ **Pending:** Equipment without registered inspection

**Alert List:**
- Equipment with problems or pending items
- Equipment with expired or rejected inspections
dashboard.howToUseContent:
**To see equipment details:**
1. Go to **"Inspections"** in the bottom menu
2. Select the equipment type
3. Tap on the desired equipment

**To register new equipment:**
1. Go to **"Inspections"**
2. Select the equipment type
3. Tap the **"+"** button in the bottom right corner

**To see history:**
- Tap **"History"** in the bottom menu
dashboard.faqAccessEquipment: How do I access a specific equipment?
dashboard.faqAccessEquipmentAnswer: Go to "Inspections" → Select the type → Tap on the desired equipment.
dashboard.faqAlertsAnswer: Check the indicated equipment and register a new inspection or corrective action.

qr.tipFormat: The QR Code may be in industrial format (e.g., 2#7036#EXT#008851#47#31)
qr.tipScan: Keep the QR Code within the reading area and wait for automatic detection.

scbaChecklist.pressureTest: 1. Lock the demand valve (bypass). 2. Open and close the cylinder valve completely. 3. Monitor the gauges for 1 minute. 4. Criterion: Pressure drop must be less than 10 bar.
scbaChecklist.lowPressureAlarm: 1. With the system still pressurized, slowly release air through the purge button. 2. Observe the gauge. 3. Criterion: The audible alarm must trigger between 50-55 bar.
scbaChecklist.maskSeal: 1. Put on the mask and adjust the straps. 2. Cover the demand valve inlet with your hand. 3. Inhale gently. 4. Criterion: The mask must be sucked against the face and remain so, without leaks.

inspection.title: About Inspection
inspection.content: Fill in the inspection data carefully. For equipment with a checklist, verify each item. If you find problems, take a photo and describe the non-conformity.

serviceType.title: Service Type
serviceType.content:
• Inspection: Monthly visual check.
• Maintenance Level 2: Annual recharge and maintenance.
• Maintenance Level 3: Hydrostatic test every 5 years.

multigasReference.title: Reference Values
multigasReference.content: Enter the exact values described on the calibration cylinder label (standard gas). These values are essential to calculate if the equipment is within the allowed error margin.

checklist.title: Inspection Checklist
checklist.content: Check each item in the list carefully. If an item is non-conforming, mark it as 'Non-Conforming'. If the item does not apply to this equipment, mark it as 'N/A'.

addEquipment.title: Register Equipment
addEquipment.content: Fill in the basic information of your equipment. If you don't have an asset ID, leave the field blank for the system to generate one automatically.

equipmentId.title: Equipment ID
equipmentId.content: This is the unique identifier for your equipment. It can be the asset number, tag, or serial number. If you prefer, the system can generate one for you.

gps.title: GPS Coordinates
gps.content: The coordinates in the registration only serve to fix the initial installation point. During inspections, the system will capture the exact location of the moment.

dashboard.title: Dashboard Tips
dashboard.content: Track your plant's status. Colored rings indicate OK inspections (green), expired (red), and pending (yellow). Tap on alerts for details.

actionPlans.title: Action Plans
actionPlans.content: Here you find the tasks needed to correct non-conformities found during inspections. Resolve pending items and attach evidence to keep your history up to date.

equipmentList.title: Equipment List
equipmentList.content: View all your equipment of this type. Tap an item to see details or the '+' button to add a new one. The status is automatically updated after each inspection.

photoRequired.title: Photo Required
photoRequired.content: Photo is required when there is non-conformity or in annual functional tests. Attach a clear image of the problem or test in progress.

approvalStatus.title: Approval
approvalStatus.content: Mark 'Yes' if equipment is in compliance. 'No' if there are problems that need correction.

observations.title: Observations
observations.content: Describe problems found, actions taken, or relevant information. This information will appear in the history.

chamberType.title: Chamber Type
chamberType.content: Select according to application: MCS (fixed tanks), TC (cascade), TF (floating roof) or MBS (dikes).

agentType.title: Agent Type
agentType.content: Select the extinguishing agent according to fire class: Water (A), Powder (A/B/C), CO2 (B/C) or Foam (A/B).

capacity.title: Capacity
capacity.content: Enter capacity in kg (powder/CO2) or liters (water/foam). Select standard value or choose 'Other' to specify.

equipmentId.title: Equipment ID
equipmentId.content: Optional. If left empty, a unique ID will be automatically generated based on equipment type and timestamp.

addEquipment.title: Add Equipment
addEquipment.content: Fill in the equipment information. Fields marked with an asterisk (*) are mandatory. Use the lightbulb icons for more details about each field.

mcsNumber.title: MCS Number
mcsNumber.content: The MCS number indicates the foam chamber capacity (flow rate in liters/minute). Select according to equipment specification.

lelCylinder.title: LEL Cylinder
lelCylinder.content: Lower Explosive Limit (LEL) concentration of the calibration cylinder standard gas. This value is used as a reference to validate detector readings during tests.

o2Cylinder.title: O2 Cylinder
o2Cylinder.content: Oxygen (O2) concentration of the calibration cylinder standard gas. This value is used as a reference to validate detector readings during tests.

h2sCylinder.title: H2S Cylinder
h2sCylinder.content: Hydrogen sulfide (H2S) concentration of the calibration cylinder standard gas. This value is used as a reference to validate detector readings during tests.

coCylinder.title: CO Cylinder
coCylinder.content: Carbon monoxide (CO) concentration of the calibration cylinder standard gas. This value is used as a reference to validate detector readings during tests.

errorMargin.title: Cylinder Error Margin
errorMargin.content: Tolerance margin in percentage for cylinder values during inspections. The default value is 20%. During tests, the system will check if the difference between the read values and the cylinder reference values is within this margin.

hoseDiameter.title: Hose Diameter
hoseDiameter.content: Internal diameter of the hose in millimeters (mm). Common values: 38mm (1.5"), 50mm (2"), 65mm (2.5"), 75mm (3") or 100mm (4").

hoseLength.title: Hose Length
hoseLength.content: Total length of the hose in meters (m). Enter the length according to equipment specification or actual measurement.

scbaMaskSerial.title: Mask Serial Number
scbaMaskSerial.content: Serial number of the SCBA face mask. This number is usually engraved on the mask and is used for traceability and maintenance control.

scbaSecondStageSerial.title: Second Stage Serial Number
scbaSecondStageSerial.content: Serial number of the SCBA second stage regulator (demand valve). This component controls the air flow to the user and also has a serial number for traceability.

expired.body: {equipment_type} ({equipment_id}) is expired and requires immediate attention.

multipleExpired.bodySingular: You have 1 equipment that requires attention.
multipleExpired.bodyPlural: You have {count} equipment that require attention.

registrationError.body: Unable to register equipment. Please check the data and try again.

created.body: {inspection_type} inspection for {equipment_type} ({equipment_id}) has been created successfully.

expiringSoon.title: ⏰ Inspection Due Soon
expiringSoon.body: {equipment_type} ({equipment_id}) has an inspection expiring in {days} day(s).

multipleAlerts.title: ⚠️ Attention Required
multipleAlerts.body: You have {count} alert(s) that require your attention.

pendingIssues.title: 📋 Pending Issues Found
pendingIssues.body: {equipment_type} ({equipment_id}) has pending issues that need to be resolved.
